bibl.title: Studies on the Derveni Papyrus. Volume 2.
bibl.seg: Glenn W. Most (ed.), Studies on the Derveni Papyrus. Volume 2.
Oxford, Oxford University Press, 2022, 405 pp., figg. ISBN 978-0-19-285595-4. $115.
C.R. par John Palmer, CR N.S., 73 (2023) pp. 433-436.
bibl.note: The volume arises from a colloquium held at the Scuola Normale Superiore (Pisa, Italy) on 2-3 March 2018. - Introduction. - I. Two Editions of the First Columns. - II. Questions of Unity. - III. Heraclitus and the Derveni Author. - IV. Other Aspects of the Papyrus. - Pp. 349-370: Bibliography. - Indexes.
